title: Indiana Code Title 6, Article 3.1, Chapter 21 (Earned Income Tax Credit)
verified_how: Not verified on the register on 2026-10-20 (no permitted route). Chapter from general knowledge.
notes: Indiana's earned income tax credit is computed as a percentage of the federal earned income credit under 26 U.S.C. s 32 (IRC subject; the percentage is unverified (general knowledge)). The plan's 'unified elderly credit' (IC 6-3-3-9) sits in IC 6-3, already indexed as indiana-code-title-6-article-3-state-income-taxes.
